title: Local IP Finder
description: Detect LAN IP via WebRTC STUN and look up your public egress IP

lan.title: LAN IP
lan.description: Browsers have no direct API to read your local network IP, so this uses the WebRTC + STUN trick. It may find more than one IP if you have multiple network interfaces.
lan.noResult: No LAN IP candidates were found — this can happen due to browser restrictions or your network environment.
lan.mdnsTitle: Your browser hid the real LAN IP
lan.mdnsDescription: Recent versions of Chrome replace the real LAN IP with an mDNS-obfuscated hostname (like xxxxxxxx-xxxx-....local) for privacy, so it can't be read directly. Open chrome://flags, search for "Anonymize local IPs exposed by WebRTC", disable it, and retry — or use a different browser.

public.title: Public Egress IP
public.description: Look up the public IP address your network exposes to the internet.
public.error: Request failed, please try again later
